name: Delorazepam
summary: THe drug is also known as chlordesmethyldiazepam. This uncommon benzodiazepine compound is primarily used for treatment of anxiety disorders and alcohol withdrawal, due to its long half-life (60-140 hours). It is also the active metabolite of diclazepam and cloxazolam.
doseBasis: NOTE: Higher doses increase the chances of blacking out. 1mg Delorazepam is approximately equal to 10mg Diazepam.
